cbr_leg.consequence: The College Basketball Reference season-schedule leg remains documented-only and UNPINNED. Precondition (c) of the CBB_TORVIK_EFFICIENCY_V1 design screen (three-way fixture agreement) therefore cannot claim its CBR leg from this manifest; no three-way agreement may be asserted until CBR bytes are lawfully pulled and pinned by a successor record.
cbr_leg.method: serial GET of https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/seasons/men/<ending-year>-schedule.html for ending years 2015..2023 (seasons 2014-15 .. 2022-23), honest User-Agent, >=5s spacing. First request (2015) returned HTTP 403; Sports Reference bot policy is fail-closed (403/429 = stop), so the remaining seasons were not attempted. No circumvention was attempted.

identity_note: Unchanged from PR #2835: the ESPN/Torvik/NCAA identity crosswalk is OPEN and NOT admitted; this manifest pins schedule bytes only and admits no identity mapping. Name-only joins remain refused outside the design screen's own audited, design-evidence-only expedient (PR #2843 S2).
known_limitations: RELEASE TAGS ARE ROLLING, NOT IMMUTABLE (PR #2835, verified-by-pull): assets are replaced in place under the stable tag espn_mens_college_basketball_schedules. This pin attests the bytes as pulled at retrieved_at_utc; stability is NOT claimed. The historical-season assets carried updated_at values in 2023 at pull time, but that is an observation, not a guarantee.

Formats are pinned independently; one format's pin never vouches for another. The .rds twin of each season exists upstream and is NOT pinned here: it is not a consumed route in this repo (same treatment as PR #2835, which pinned no .rds asset).
parquet samples are admitted on bytes + hash; row content is cross-verified through each season's CSV twin (no working parquet reader in the SportsEdge runtime at admission time).

CSV schema differs by season: the 2023 file carries additional columns (broadcast, current-rank, linescores, records blocks) and is ~2x the bytes of earlier seasons. Consumers must not assume one schema across seasons.

Season 2020 ends 2020-03-11 and season 2021 is short (4,285 rows, starting 2020-11-25): both are the true historical record (COVID-19 cancellation / shortened season), not missing data. Season 2023 flags status_type_completed on 6,228/6,261 rows while both final scores are populated on all 6,261 rows; the design screen's fixture-agreement step is where such rows are adjudicated.
The College Basketball Reference leg is UNPINNED (HTTP 403 refusal recorded in cbr_leg). The three-way agreement of design S2/S3(c) cannot be completed from this manifest.
This repo commits hashes, manifests and retrieval code only — no data files.
pin_rule: tag + release ID + asset ID + asset size + asset updated_at + SHA-256 of the downloaded bytes, all recorded in this manifest at pull time, together with the pull timestamp (retrieved_at_utc). The release is ROLLING (assets replaced in place under a stable tag), so the pin attests the bytes as pulled at retrieved_at_utc — the strongest attestation this source supports; it does NOT attest that upstream bytes are stable or immutable. Any later byte drift against this manifest is SOURCE_CHANGED_AFTER_SNAPSHOT (refusal), never silent acceptance.
